kjv: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

lines.say: Good morning. Whatever trouble is waiting today, hear this first.
lines.small: Whatever trouble is waiting today, hear this first.

lines.say: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. Psalm forty six, verse one.
lines.big: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

lines.say: Not a help once things calm down. A present help, right in the middle of it.
lines.big: Not a help once things calm down. A present help, right in the middle of it.

lines.say: Lord, be my refuge and my strength today. I'm leaning on you. In Jesus' name, amen.
Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.
